ar.title: دجاج مخبوز مع طماطم وبصل
ar.intro: طبق دجاج مخبوز كلاسيكي، سهل وسريع التحضير.

steps.n2: امزج التوابل مع الملح والفلفل وافرك الدجاج بها بخفة.
steps.n3: ضع القطع في صينية خبز مدهونة بقليل بالزيت وغطِّها بالبصل والطماطم المتبّل.
steps.n4: اخبز في فرن معتدل معاد تسخينه لمدة 60–90 دقيقة مع الريّ بعصائر الصينية.
steps.n5: اغلظ العصائر بنشا الذرة إذا أردت.
steps.n6: طريقة بديلة مع الجزر والكرفس: اسمّر البصل المفروم والكرفس بالزيت، غطِّ الدجاج بهما وبشرائح جزر مطبوخة قليلاً وفصوص ثوم مقسومة بطريقة قطرية، صب مرق اللحم وأخبز بنفس الطريقة.

en.title: Baked Chicken with Tomatoes and Onions (Tagin Firakh)
en.intro: Recipe 109, page 50 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n2: Mix the spice with salt and pepper and rub it lightly over the chicken.
steps.n3: Lay the pieces in a lightly greased roasting pan and cover them with the seasoned onions and tomatoes.
steps.n4: Bake in a moderate, preheated oven for 60–90 minutes, basting with the pan juices.
steps.n5: Thicken the juices with cornflour if you like.
steps.n6: With carrots and celery (recipe 110 in the book): brown chopped onions and celery in oil, cover the chicken with them and with parboiled carrot rounds and halved garlic cloves, pour meat stock over and bake the same way.

legacySteps: Mix the spice with salt and pepper and rub it lightly over the chicken.
Lay the pieces in a lightly greased roasting pan and cover them with the seasoned onions and tomatoes.
Bake in a moderate, preheated oven for 60–90 minutes, basting with the pan juices.
Thicken the juices with cornflour if you like.

With carrots and celery (recipe 110 in the book): brown chopped onions and celery in oil, cover the chicken with them and with parboiled carrot rounds and halved garlic cloves, pour meat stock over and bake the same way.
